name: fars.deaths_per_year
note: FARS census: persons killed (INJ_SEV 4, death within 30 days)

name: fars.deaths_per_year.speeding
note: Police judgement, ascertained more thoroughly in fatal crashes; mixes exceeding the limit with 'too fast for conditions'. Crashes with unknown status are NOT counted (count is a lower bound in that respect).

name: fars.deaths_per_year.speeding_exceeded_limit
note: The part of speeding that automated enforcement acts on. Lower bound: crashes coded 'speeding, specifics unknown' may also have exceeded the limit.

name: fars.deaths_per_year.alcohol
note: expected value over 10 BAC implicates (n = deaths with a non-zero probability); FARS and CRSS definitions differ (BAC>=.08 vs police-reported involvement). The FARS count is an expectation over imputations, not a count of tested drivers.

name: fars.deaths_per_year.drugs
note: LOW reliability: drug status is unknown for about half of fatal crashes, testing is selective by injury severity and state, and presence is not impairment (docs/audit/alcohol_drugs.md 4.1, 5.5).

name: fars.deaths_per_year.unrestrained_lpv
note: Police-reported restraint; deaths with unknown restraint status are NOT counted. CRSS belt use among survivors is largely self-reported and likely over-reported. The primary belt estimate (double-pair comparison) comes from driver/right-front pairs; applying it to other front and second-row occupants is an extrapolation.

name: fars.deaths_per_year.speeding.status_unknown
unit: deaths/year in crashes whose status is unknown
note: not included in the segment count; the segment count is a lower bound

name: fars.deaths_per_year.speeding_exceeded_limit.status_unknown
unit: deaths/year in crashes whose status is unknown or 'speeding, specifics unknown'
note: not included in the segment count; the segment count is a lower bound

name: fars.deaths_per_year.drugs.status_unknown
unit: deaths/year in crashes whose status is unknown
note: not included in the segment count; the segment count is a lower bound

name: fars.deaths_per_year.unrestrained_lpv.status_unknown
unit: deaths/year of belt-eligible LPV occupants with unknown restraint use
note: not included in the segment count; the segment count is a lower bound
